title: Allocations from Returned Payments on a Deferred-Interest Plan — Crestline Credit Card
content:
On a Crestline Credit Card deferred-interest plan, an allocation to the plan from a payment later returned unpaid never reduced the plan, so it is added back to the plan's balance left; this is figured for an account on which no payment returned unpaid before the most recent returned payment carried an allocation to the plan, and only the most recent returned payment is looked at: when its allocation to the plan was recorded on or before the closing date of the plan's last recorded accrual, interest on it at the daily rate for each day from its allocation date through the last day of the period, both days counted, is added; when it was recorded after that closing date, interest on it for each stub day is added; otherwise nothing is added. The interest added increases the deferred interest Northgate assesses on the plan.

**Records read:** the most recent returned payment on the card ledger (its payment confirmation number), and the allocation entries of that payment to the plan, with their amounts and dates.

- **Recorded balance:** the plan's purchase amount less the payment allocations recorded for it and less the merchandise credits that carry its ticket number.
- **Daily rate:** the account's purchase rate divided by 365 (the product's daily rate basis in days).
- **Stub days:** the days from the day after the closing date of the plan's last recorded accrual through the last day of its period (its expiration date).

## Decision table

| Most recent returned payment's allocation to the plan | Interest added |
|---|---|
| recorded on or before the last accrual's closing date | allocation multiplied by the daily rate, multiplied by the days from the allocation date through the last day of the period, both counted |
| recorded after that closing date | allocation multiplied by the daily rate, multiplied by the stub days |
| none | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

Hypothetical figures use a purchase rate of 36.5 percent, so that the daily rate is a round 0.1 percent.

- A 200.00 USD allocation recorded 20 May, last accrual closing 10 June, period's last day 14 June: 20 May to 14 June is 26 days; 5.20 USD is added.
- The same allocation recorded 12 June: 4 stub days; 0.80 USD is added.
